rules.name: pin
rules.content: Pin the cass-memory linux binary by sha256 before executing it. CMK_PIN
rules.query: verify the sha256 of the cass-memory linux binary before it runs

rules.name: fixtures
rules.content: Keep eval fixtures as small text under the evq1107 directory. CMK_FIX
rules.query: where should small text eval fixtures live under evq1107

rules.name: spell
rules.content: Spell the product name Gom Jabbar in operator sentences. CMK_SPELL
rules.query: how should operator sentences spell Gom Jabbar

rules.name: auth
rules.content: Do not commit auth.json or any API key value. CMK_AUTH
rules.query: which secret file named auth.json must stay uncommitted

rules.name: home
rules.content: Redirect TMPDIR and HOME before a tool writes its own dot directory. CMK_HOME
rules.query: which env vars to redirect so a tool dot directory stays out of the real HOME

rules.name: trading
rules.content: Leave trading code untouched while LIVE_HARD_OFF stays true. CMK_TRADE
rules.query: what must stay untouched in trading code while LIVE_HARD_OFF is true

rules.name: check
rules.content: When one stage card changes, run catalog_check before the lane ends. CMK_CHK
rules.query: which check command runs before the lane ends after a stage card change

rules.name: registry
rules.content: When one stage card changes, leave the shared registry json untouched. CMK_REG
rules.query: which shared registry json stays untouched when one stage card changes

distractor.name: plant
distractor.content: Water the office plant every Friday morning. CMK_PLANT
